name: Independent motions from the second row

setup.note: j moves down to a2, our reset point.

notes.note: Every lesson begins again at a2.

actions.label: Move down
actions.caption: Press j to move down one row, keeping your place in the list.

actions.label: Move up
actions.caption: Press k to move up one row. We reset to a2 first; this lands on a1.
